description: This file defines an abstract class CommandControl for a UI component in a Java Swing application, used to control commands like 'Test' and 'Set' for a hardware or system interface. It provides UI elements such as buttons and labels, and handles user interactions to send commands via CommandQueue.

classes.name: CommandControl
classes.description: An abstract Swing UI component class providing a panel with command buttons and labels, facilitating command sending through a queue.

methods.name: CommandControl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components, including label, icon, and command button, and sets up the action listener to send commands.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Creates an ActionListener that writes the command returned by getCommand() to CommandQueue when triggered.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the specific command string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the UI component (panel) wrapped for display.
